name: stag-plugin-clip
description: Stag Clip: agents find the best moments in long videos (podcasts, streams; YouTube, Twitch, Kick or a file) from the video's existing transcript and cut them into clips.

stagPlugin.description: Agents find the best moments in long videos from the video's existing transcript and cut them into clips, keeping the original frame and audio. Runs yt-dlp and ffmpeg on this computer (it can download them for you) and only downloads the parts it cuts. You review the clips on the Stag Clip page.
stagPlugin.author: stag.ai

tools.name: clip_fetch
tools.description: Step 1 of Stag Clip (find the best moments in a long video and cut them into clips). Reads a video's details and its existing transcript, without downloading the video. source = a YouTube / Twitch / Kick URL, a video file path, or a source id. Returns the source id, duration, transcript language and the user's clip defaults. If the video has no transcript, tell the user and stop.

source.description: Video URL, video file path, or source id

lang.description: Transcript language code (e.g. en, vi). Default: the video's own language

tools.name: clip_transcript
tools.description: Read a source's transcript as timestamped sentences, one page at a time. Read the whole video page by page before choosing clips. The transcript is in the video's language; write clip titles and reasons in the user's language.

source.description: Source id from clip_fetch (or the URL / path)

from.description: Start of the range: seconds or h:mm:ss. Default 0

to.description: End of the range: seconds or h:mm:ss. Default: end of video

lang.description: Another transcript language listed by clip_fetch

tools.name: clip_cut
tools.description: Cut one clip from a source. start / end in seconds or h:mm:ss. The cut snaps to sentence boundaries (a few seconds of drift is normal). The clip keeps the original frame and audio; no subtitles are burned in. Only that part of an online video is downloaded. The user reviews each clip on the Stag Clip page (keep / drop).

title.description: Short title in the user's language

reason.description: One sentence: why this moment works (user's language)

snap.description: Snap to sentence boundaries. Default true

tools.name: clip_signals
tools.description: Hints about where the good moments are in a source: YouTube "most replayed" peaks, the busiest chat replay moments (with laughs), and loudness peaks (files on this computer). Use them to decide where to read the transcript closely; the transcript decides what makes a good clip.

tools.name: clip_list
tools.description: List the clips already cut from a source and the user's decision on each (waiting / kept / dropped), so you do not cut the same moment twice.
